from bisect import bisect_left

def taller_within(a, k):
    n = len(a)
    vals = sorted(set(a))
    idx = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(vals)}
    bit = [0] * (len(vals) + 1)
    res = [0] * n
    size = 0
    for i, v in enumerate(a):
        p = idx[v] + 1
        total_le = 0
        x = p
        while x:
            total_le += bit[x]
            x -= x & -x
        res[i] = size - total_le
        # add v
        x = p
        while x <= len(vals):
            bit[x] += 1
            x += x & -x
        size += 1
        # evict index i-k (now out of window for next iteration)
        j = i - k
        if j >= 0:
            vj = a[j]
            pj = idx[vj] + 1
            x = pj
            while x <= len(vals):
                bit[x] -= 1
                x += x & -x
            size -= 1
    return res

from bisect import bisect_left


def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    vals = sorted(set(a))
    m = len(vals)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    res = [0] * n
    size = 0

    for i, v in enumerate(a):
        p = bisect_left(vals, v) + 1
        # count of window elements with height <= v
        le = 0
        x = p
        while x:
            le += bit[x]
            x -= x & -x
        res[i] = size - le

        # insert a[i] into window
        x = p
        while x <= m:
            bit[x] += 1
            x += x & -x
        size += 1

        # evict index i-k, which falls out of the window [i-k, i)
        j = i - k
        if j >= 0:
            pj = bisect_left(vals, a[j]) + 1
            x = pj
            while x <= m:
                bit[x] -= 1
                x += x & -x
            size -= 1

    return res
